symptoms.title: Early dark spots
symptoms.description: Small black or dark necrotic spots initially appear on the banana leaves.

symptoms.title: Expanding brown lesions
symptoms.description: The spots enlarge and develop into larger brown necrotic lesions.

symptoms.title: Yellow halos
symptoms.description: Lesions are commonly surrounded by a yellow/chlorotic halo.

symptoms.title: Pale lesion centers
symptoms.description: The center of the lesion becomes light brown to white as it develops.

symptoms.title: Varied lesion shapes
symptoms.description: Lesions may become oval, elongated, or diamond-shaped, depending on the banana cultivar.

symptoms.title: Extensive leaf damage
symptoms.description: Severe infection causes lesions to expand and extensive leaf tissue to become necrotic and damaged.

treatment.title: Remove affected leaves
treatment.description: Remove infected or severely affected leaves as part of field sanitation and disease management.

treatment.title: Monitor affected plants
treatment.description: Regularly monitor affected plants for the development or progression of symptoms.

treatment.title: Support plant health
treatment.description: Maintain appropriate crop-management practices that support plant health.

treatment.title: Manage moisture, drainage and stress
treatment.description: Manage environmental and cultural conditions that may favor disease development, including poor drainage, excessive moisture, and plant stress.

treatment.title: Use agriculturally supported control measures
treatment.description: Use appropriate disease-control measures when necessary and when supported by applicable agricultural recommendations.

treatment.title: Treat biological control as emerging or complementary
treatment.description: Biological control may be considered an emerging or complementary management approach, but research findings should not be presented as an established treatment protocol.

treatment.title: Monitor after management measures
treatment.description: Continue monitoring disease development after management measures are applied.

prevention.title: Inspect banana leaves regularly
prevention.description: Conduct regular field inspection and monitoring of banana leaves.

prevention.title: Remove infected or severely affected leaves
prevention.description: Remove infected or severely affected leaves as part of field sanitation.

prevention.title: Maintain crop and environmental management
prevention.description: Maintain appropriate crop and environmental management practices.

prevention.title: Avoid leaving infected material unnecessarily
prevention.description: Avoid allowing infected plant material to remain unnecessarily within the production area.

prevention.title: Maintain water, drainage and plant health
prevention.description: Maintain plant health through appropriate water, drainage, and general crop management.

prevention.title: Watch for new symptoms
prevention.description: Monitor plants for new symptoms so that affected foliage can be managed promptly.

prevention.title: Consider biological control subject to validation
prevention.description: Consider biological control as a potential complementary or future approach subject to further validation.
